basic.name: Aeolian Mode: Echoes in Still Waters
basic.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{value}}% of Hysilens's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Overtone Hum: Chorus After Dark Tides
skill.description_template: Has a 100% base chance to increase the DMG taken by all enemies by {{damage_taken}}%, lasting for 3 turn(s). At the same time, deals Physical DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Hysilens's ATK to all enemies.

ultimate.name: Maelstrom Rhapsody
ultimate.description_template:
Hysilens deploys a Zone that reduces enemy targets' ATK by 15% and DEF by {{defense_reduction}}%, and deals Physical DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Hysilens's ATK to all enemies.
For every 1 instance of DoT taken by an enemy target within the Zone, Hysilens deals Physical DoT equal to {{additional_damage}}% of her ATK to them. This damage triggers at the start of each turn or after one attack by an ally target, up to 8 time(s). And it cannot repeatedly trigger this effect. The Zone lasts for 3 turn(s) and this duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. When Hysilens gets knocked down, the Zone will also be dispelled.

talent.name: Sirenic Serenade
talent.description_template:
When an ally target attacks, there is a 100% base chance for Hysilens to inflict the hit enemy target with one of the following states: Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, or Shock. Priority is given to inflicting a different state. While in the Wind Shear/Burn/Shock state, at the start of each turn, the enemy target takes Wind/Fire/Lightning DoT equal to {{damage}}% of Hysilens's ATK for 2 turn(s).
While in the Bleed state, at the start of each turn, the enemy target takes Physical DoT equal to 20% of their Max HP, up to {{physical_damage}}% of Hysilens's ATK, lasting for 2 turn(s).

technique.name: At Ocean's Abode
technique.description:
After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for 20 seconds and automatically moves forward. Enemies within the Special Dimension enter the "Soulstruck" state. "Soulstruck" enemies will not attack ally targets and will follow the dimension while it persists.
After entering combat with "Soulstruck" enemies, there is a 100% base chance to inflict each enemy target with 2 of the following states: Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock, all of which are equivalent to those provided by Hysilens's Talent effect. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

2.name: The Gladius of Conquest
2.description: At the start of combat, Hysilens deploys a Zone, equivalent to that provided by her Ultimate, lasting for 3 turn(s). Whenever Hysilens deploys a Zone, she recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

4.name: The Bubble of Banquets
4.description: When Hysilens uses Ultimate, if the enemy target is currently afflicted with DoT(s), all DoTs currently applied on the target will immediately produce DMG equal to 150% of their original DMG.

6.name: The Fiddle of Pearls
6.description: For every 10% of Hysilens's Effect Hit Rate that exceeds 60%, increases her DMG dealt by 15%, up to a max increase of 90%.

eidolons.name: You Ask Why Hearts Cry
eidolons.description: While Hysilens is on the field, the DoT dealt by ally targets is equal to 116% of their original value. When Hysilens inflicts Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock on enemies via her Talent, there is a 100% base chance to additionally inflict the target with 1 instance of Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock state that is equivalent to those from the original Talent effect and can coexist with such pre-existing states.

eidolons.name: Tell Me Why Waves Roar High
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, the DMG Boost effect from Trace "The Fiddle of Pearls" applies to all allies.

eidolons.name: Why Do Lights Bid Goodbye
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Lo, How Time Flows By
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, reduces All-Type RES of all enemies by 20%.

eidolons.name: In Ablution, I Hum and Sigh
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: When to Return From Where You Lie
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, at the start of each turn or after one attack by an ally target, increases the maximum trigger count for Hysilens's Physical DoT effect to 12, and increases the multiplier of the DMG dealt by 20%.
